seam.sonar: run_sonar_analysis(wd, revision=<full analyzed sha>) — fetch-first, revision-scoped project key, stale-refused honored; payload {status, revision_matches|None, new_critical_count|None, analyzed_sha}
seam.lsp: run_diagnostics(wd, profile) at the phase commit's tree state; payload {status, new_error_count|None, tool}
seam.deadline: ANALYZER_LEG_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 360.0, same ThreadPoolExecutor hard-deadline discipline as the graph leg; a non-returning analyzer degrades to its measured unavailable status (terms omitted, never a fabricated zero, never a hung phase)
seam.new_critical_count_semantics: bugs + vulnerabilities (reliability + security defects) — the release-blocking classes, NOT maintainability code smells
seam.revision_matches_semantics: true iff status==available (analysis confirmed to cover revision), false iff stale-refused, null iff unavailable (omitted)

test_suite.command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_change_analyzer.py tests/test_workflow_runner.py tests/test_run_workflow_graph_cli.py tests/test_code_change_facts.py tests/test_versioned_graph.py tests/test_graph.py tests/test_dependency_direction.py tests/test_evidence_prereq_gate.py

hermetic_verifications.c_hanging_analyzer_degrades_within_deadl: test_change_analysis_hanging_analyzer_degrades_within_deadline — 1s deadline over a 10s hang, both statuses unavailable

live_probe.agent_note: Deterministic stand-in performs the real file edit; every seam leg AFTER the commit is real (git, tree-sitter, sonar-scanner, LSP probe, Neo4j graph, reducer)
